description: The estimated fair forward rate for a currency pair and tenor, by covered interest parity from an independent mid and central bank policy rates, with its margin of error, and what hedging costs or earns per year. Free. With a paid key and quotedRate, the forward a bank quoted is held to it: how much is margin.

amount.description: Optional notional in the from currency, to state the margin in money.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency sold forward, e.g. 'USD'.

quotedRate.description: Optional. The forward rate a bank quoted (units of to per from).

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency received, e.g. 'ZAR'.

name: swapeazi_forward
title: Fair forward and hedge cost
